titre: Rook takes bishop. Legal, or illegal? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Legal, or illegal? 👇 1.Rxc4 is illegal: the rook is pinned to the king. 1.Rxe8+! is legal, and wins (Stockfish 16, composed position). One new puzzle every day.
